title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-10-10
ranking_basis: GitHub Trending daily stars gained, sorted descending
ranking_explanation: Daily stars-gained figures and page-displayed total stars were captured from GitHub Trending today. Entries are sorted by daily gains, not by total stars. GitHub REST API repository metadata and current default-branch commits corroborated all entries.
global_caveat: Trending gains and total-star counts are a live snapshot and may change between requests; popularity is not a proxy for quality or adoption. One repo has no primary language listed on GitHub Trending.

sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time: 2026-10-10 00:29 UTC. Scope: daily. Date range: 2026-10-10 through 2026-10-10. Ranking basis: GitHub Trending daily stars gained, sorted descending.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI-agent workflows dominate today's leaders: the biggest spikes are an agent-assisted reverse-engineering toolkit and a PS5 executable porting project, followed by practical engineering skills and diagram tooling. The list also spans code review, model routing, creative software, and 3D reconstruction.

sections.title: morluto/rea
sections.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
sections.why_notable: The day's strongest star-gain signal by a wide margin; its README describes an MCP server and workflows spanning native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, and websites.
sections.unique_caveat: Analysis is locally run and conclusions include evidence and limitations; native analysis may depend on a separately installed analysis engine.

enrichment.architecture_summary: An MCP server and companion workflows connect agents to local analysis tools across native binaries, JS/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, and websites.
enrichment.workflow: Install with npx rea-agents setup, approve agent configuration changes, then ask an agent to analyze a target and surface evidence.
enrichment.design_pattern: Local evidence-producing analysis exposed through agent-compatible tools.

sections.title: boykopovar/AnyPS5
sections.description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
sections.why_notable: Second by daily gains; its README describes executable relinking and system-library implementations rather than emulation or a separate runtime process.
sections.unique_caveat: Compatibility is limited to the games and system-library functions the project has tested or implemented; its README directs users to a compatibility list.

enrichment.architecture_summary: A relinker converts executables to the target system's native format, with project implementations of system PRX libraries for dynamic linking.
enrichment.workflow: Build the tool, use the documented porting process, and check the verified-game compatibility list; unsupported states terminate with an error.
enrichment.design_pattern: Native-format relinking plus progressively implemented system-library compatibility, rather than a separate emulation runtime.

sections.title: storytold/artcraft
sections.description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
sections.why_notable: A substantial creative-tooling counterpoint among the day's software-agent and developer-tool surges.
sections.unique_caveat: The available project description is high-level; avoid asserting detailed capabilities beyond its stated creative-engine purpose.

sections.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
sections.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, and Pi. 42 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
sections.why_notable: Strong momentum in agent-ready design tooling; its README describes 44 diagram types and output that can be opened as a standalone file.
sections.unique_caveat: README metadata differs on the diagram-type count (Trending description says 42; current README says 44); report uses the README's current count where stated.

enrichment.architecture_summary: An agent skill that selects a diagram form and generates a self-contained HTML+SVG artifact styled with design rules and optionally a target site's brand.
enrichment.workflow: Install the skill, request a diagram in natural language, review the agent's stated plan, and open the generated HTML file.
enrichment.design_pattern: Portable, single-file visual deliverables with cross-agent skill distribution.

sections.title: mattpocock/skills
sections.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
sections.why_notable: The largest total-star base among today's listed leaders and a high daily gain; the project emphasizes small, composable workflows across agent hosts.
sections.unique_caveat: The README presents this as a personal collection of adaptable skills; suitability depends on each user's workflow.

enrichment.architecture_summary: A collection of small, composable engineering and productivity skills distributed through agent plugins or editable files.
enrichment.workflow: Choose one installation path per agent, install the skills, then run the setup skill to configure issue-tracker and documentation preferences.
enrichment.design_pattern: Composable, portable instructions rather than a single workflow framework that owns the full development process.

sections.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
sections.description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
sections.why_notable: Shows agent tooling expanding beyond coding into knowledge-work plugins.
sections.unique_caveat: The repository description identifies Claude Cowork as its primary audience.

sections.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
sections.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
sections.why_notable: Reinforces demand for reusable, production-focused agent instructions, with more than 100,000 total stars.
sections.unique_caveat: The short repository description does not establish comparative production quality.

sections.title: alibaba/open-code-review
sections.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
sections.why_notable: Its README describes a diff-aware reviewer with tool use, contextual file inspection, and structured line-level comments, representing a more specialized engineering-agent workflow.
sections.unique_caveat: The README states the benchmark favors precision over recall; it may miss defects in exchange for reducing false positives.

enrichment.architecture_summary: A code-review CLI combines deterministic rule pipelines with a configurable LLM agent that can inspect files and search the repository for context.
enrichment.workflow: Configure a model endpoint, run the CLI on a diff or scan target files, then review structured findings.
enrichment.design_pattern: Hybrid deterministic and agent review, targeting precise actionable findings over maximal recall.

sections.title: Robbyant/lingbot-map
sections.description: [ECCV 2026 Best Paper Award Candidate] LingBot-Map: Geometric Context Transformer for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
sections.why_notable: Adds a research-oriented computer-vision project to a list otherwise led by agent and developer tools.
sections.unique_caveat: The award language is the repository's own description; it is not treated here as an independently verified award result.

sections.title: BerriAI/litellm
sections.description: The fastest, litest AI Gateway. Rust core with Python SDK. Call 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI (or native) format with cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing, and logging [Bedrock, Azure, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI, VertexAI, vLLM, Nvidia NIM]
sections.why_notable: A foundational infrastructure project for routing model calls, with cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing, and logging in its GitHub description.
sections.unique_caveat: Capabilities are summarized from the GitHub repository description; this report does not independently assess service reliability or provider coverage.

sections.title: twostraws/SwiftUI-Agent-Skill
sections.description: SwiftUI agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and other AI tools.
sections.why_notable: Extends the agent-skill trend into a specific application-development framework.
sections.unique_caveat: GitHub reports no primary language for this repository.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent workflows and reusable skills: REA, mattpocock/skills, anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins, addyosmani/agent-skills, diagram-design, and SwiftUI-Agent-Skill make agent integrations and task-specific instructions a strong through-line. Developer quality and infrastructure: Alibaba's OpenCodeReview and LiteLLM address code review and model-call routing. Specialized technical applications: AnyPS5, ArtCraft, and LingBot-Map cover executable portability, creative tooling, and 3D reconstruction. Languages among the ten repos with a reported language: Python (3); TypeScript, C++, Shell, HTML, Go, JavaScript, and Rust (1 each). SwiftUI-Agent-Skill has no language listed.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The standout signal is demand for agent capabilities packaged as usable workflows—especially tools that connect agents to real engineering tasks, from reverse engineering to diagrams and code review. But this is not only an agent-tools snapshot: AnyPS5 and ArtCraft demonstrate strong audience interest in concrete, domain-specific software as well. Daily star counts are a fast-moving popularity signal, not evidence of adoption or technical quality.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary source: https://github.com/trending?since=daily, captured 2026-10-10 at 00:29 UTC. Corroboration: GitHub REST API repository metadata and default-branch commits for all 11 repositories. Daily star gains and displayed totals are from the matching daily Trending view, sorted by gains. README details were consulted for the five strongest gain signals. No prior-window comparison was collected.
